notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.content:
Welcome!

Everyone likes to have a free hand and feel entirely at ease while working. That's why in the Coffee Bar Renovator, we will provide players with the opportunity to play in creative mode. Each of you will be able to get carried away by your imagination, create a fantastic cafe, and show off the renovators' community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/117ddca4d459973f0bfe7fb7d8d60ec9604e8f7e.gif[/img]

You can use all possible places available on the city map during the game. Any to-do list will not bind you throughout the renovation and decoration. The budget is unlimited—no cash limits for investments. Moreover, the work evaluation system will be automatically turned off you won't have any opportunity to sell finished premises. All tools will be made public for your convenience and flexibility. 

It is up to you to decide how you will make the destroyed buildings into beautiful and functional Coffee Bars. Do you like this solution? Be sure to let us know in the comments or Discord. If you like our content, you can furthermore share the post and forward it!

Hi coffee lovers!

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here is a quick test. Don't be afraid there are no bad answers ;) 

Think about the most popular cafes that you know. What is the first thing that comes to your mind when you think about it? 

I guess that some of you will think about the logo and it’s nothing surprising. 

A logo is a very important part of your brand identity. Thanks to that, people can remember your company and when they have to choose where to go, there is a bigger chance that they will choose something that they know, for example, your coffee bar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/98f05c6cc38184136df515aa00831f2517d7a983.png[/img]

What is a perfect logo? There is a lot of things that you should pay attention to during creating your logo but we gonna share the most basic things:

Simple - When someone will see your logo it should be easy for them to guess what your company is doing. What is more, the more complicated a logo is, there is more chance that someone will not remember it, because it will be too difficult. Try not to use more than 3 colors and create it so that it will be possible to show it in one color. 

Timeless - No matter if you see this logo in ‘91, 2021, or 2051 it should be the same accuracy. The logo shouldn’t go with trends because it passes very quickly.  

Relevant - When you are a coffee bar you want to be associated with coffee, hot drinks, maybe some desserts, etc. but not with for example steaks. Try to use colors and things connected to things you do, to your philosophy. 

Distinct - Show that your coffee bar is unique, don’t try to pose as someone else because it only brings trouble. If your logo will be too similar to someone else, your clients accidentally will mistake you for another cafe and go there or in a worse scenario, they will mistake you with the one with a bad reputation and won’t go to your place. 

That’s all for today. Did you like that? Share with us your opinion or suggestion for the next devlogs!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Everyone has to start somewhere to get to the top. If you want to build your Coffee Bar empire, you have to be creative and inventive. The whole world is waiting for you. This time we’ll talk about how to run and how to expand your business.

 You need to begin by choosing the right place to start your adventure. Pay attention to what kind of building you choose and in which district. Once you’ve decided where your first cafe will be located, start planning a renovation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/b88cb398cbb3325826a021aaa7910a53ea8e710a.gif[/img]

Before you start decorating your place,  you first need to renovate it. You will be completely free to do so. It’s up to you how it ends. You have to for example: demolish and clean the walls, exterminate the pests, vacuum, remove the mushrooms, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/d2b3dde21ec95c750e727e71ba288cdb61b88c0f.jpg[/img]

Decorating the premises is the final step before take-off. As the founder, you will have to ensure that the Coffee Bar is properly equipped. Tables, chairs, fridge, air conditioning may be useful. The selection of furniture and colors should correspond to the surroundings of the Cafe. Remember,  you need to keep the customer’s personal space. Make sure you can move freely.

Your ingenuity is the only limit.  You can also decorate your Coffee Bar by referring to specific holidays, for example: Saint Patrick’s Day, Halloween, Christmas.

Share your opinion. What’s your dream coffeehouse? Let us know in the comments section and join our discord!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello there!

Everyone knows that man does not live by coffee alone. Your menu should have more than espresso to attract people. Let’s discuss what else you can offer to your clients.


Classics
Espresso, Americano,  Latte, Flat White, Cappuccino, Mocha, Iced Coffee are the most popular choices and they’re necessary for every coffee bar.

Untypical coffees 
Your imagination is the only limit. Coffee with flowers, edible glitter or gold, alcohol, fruits, whipped cream, spices, and what do you want. You can create limited or seasonal editions. 

Other drinks
Some people don’t like coffee but want to spend time with their coffeeholic friends so it will be good to offer something for them. Iced tea for summer, warming, seasoning tea for winter days, chai latte, matcha latte, cocktails, smoothies, fresh juices, or maybe some alcohol? Everyone will find something for themselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/43d27d97e12b3ce8087d9fba51e7da3d4c117e44.png[/img]

Food
Coffee suits best with something to eat. Think if you want to sell savory things like salads, sandwiches or maybe you will focus on dessert. Tarts, pies, cheesecakes, hand-made chocolates, or crafted ice cream, yummy! 

That’s all for today. Tell us what you usually order when you are in cafes. Do you have your favorite set?

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello coffee lovers!

Is a coffee bar your second home? Or maybe you just go there only to celebrate some special events? No matter what your answer is, I guess that you can easily say what should be there. Let’s think about it.

The most important place in every cafe is the counter because magic happened there. A good coffee maker is key to creating the best coffee. Decide what type of coffee you want to serve and choose a relevant coffee maker. Do you prefer a simple and quick Espresso Machine or maybe something more complicated but eye-catching like Siphon Coffee Maker? Do you want to focus only on classics or also experiment on something new? Those questions you need to answer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/f857a92d4c74baae1250ce096c2f4871fee07815.png[/img]

The next part of your coffee bar is a space where your clients can drink their coffee. How many tables do you want? How many people will sit together? Do you prefer chairs or maybe couches?

And don’t forget about the bathrooms! If you want to keep your clients for more than five minutes they probably will need to go to the toilet. Will it be spacious and separate for women and men or maybe only a tiny one for everyone? 

ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/102b554f7e91c0bc9c22b8d4503fbcc276917946.gif[/img]

Of course, you will also need to focus on decoration to attract people. What would be your style? Vintage, modern, themed, or maybe something else? Share with us your ideas for your dreamed coffee bar! 

And don't forget to join our Discord!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Have you ever wondered how it would be to have your cafe? Have you dreamed about a small, cozy coffeehouse in the mountains? Or maybe a modern and elegant coffee bar in Paris? It depends on you!

But before you run a worldwide company, you have got enough reputation points to unlock new locations. Start with one district. Choose between some abandoned premises and start renovating them. After that, you will get access to all cities, a whole country. The world is waiting for you. Are you asking yourself: how to obtain reputation points? So simple! Do every task on your to-do list and add something more to get extra points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689993/89a4b97d8263e92afbfd7399c59d5019eaffec1c.png[/img]

Every location has its demand and type of customers who have some of their expectations. In rich localization, they will want more fancy and elegant cafes, and at the same time at a Hawaiian beach, they will expect more exotic and paradisial decor. 

I hope that you like that. Tell us what you want to know in the next devlog and [url=https://discord.gg/n5HqyqVrxp][b]join Coffee Lovers Community on Discord![/b][/url]
